# Vendored dependencies

`three-mesh-ui-6.5.31.tgz` is the exact package previously installed from
`michal-repo/three-mesh-ui` commit
`bd5a8970c50721e882c81f8a1b01ce0b77b1ade3`.

It is committed so `npm ci` does not need Git or Git-over-SSH access on a
deployment server. The package is MIT licensed; its own `LICENSE` file remains
inside the tarball.
